# Mehmet Zeki Oğuz

Mehmet Zeki Oğuz is a multilingual quality specialist based in Trondheim, Norway. His work focuses on localization, language quality, terminology, interpretation, and AI output evaluation.

## Core expertise

- Multilingual localization QA

- LLM output evaluation
- RLHF and AI quality assurance
- English, Norwegian, and Turkish language services
